confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderate confidence; July peak-season accommodation and bar prices are less certain. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against draught beer (about 3-4x). FX is from search-result summaries of RBA pages, not a direct page read; a market-data site showed 0.6971 for the same day, so verify against RBA table F11 before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No web sourcing for city prices. Benchmarked against other Vietnamese coastal resort cities such as Da Nang, with a July peak-season premium applied to accommodation.
